name: mad4b_journey_place_bindings_v1
title: Journey highlight → destination bindings (per item)

repeater-fields.name: item_number
repeater-fields.title: Highlight number (1-based)
repeater-fields.description: Temporary position for selecting the original Highlight. The permanent key is captured on save.

repeater-fields.name: destination_term_ids
repeater-fields.title: Destinations to link (multiple allowed)
repeater-fields.description: Only terms already attached to and eligible for the Tour are rendered. This field never changes Tour taxonomy assignments.

repeater-fields.name: item_key
repeater-fields.title: Stable highlight key (automatically assigned on save)
repeater-fields.description: Preserved on reorder; when the Highlight text itself changes, verify/rebind explicitly.

repeater-fields.name: rebind_on_save
repeater-fields.title: Rebind this row after editing the Highlight text
repeater-fields.description: Off by default. Turn on only to deliberately attach this place policy to the current Highlight number again. It resets after saving.

description: Select an item once, then its stable key is stored automatically. Reordering preserves the mapping. If its text changes, use Rebind this row ON and save; it resets afterward.
